scope.population: 20 captured A-share securities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing listings
scope.historical_raw_policy: No pre-2026-10-15 raw samples were read or replayed; older reports are cited only as historical research records.

sections: historical note on f107/f110 and Ulist f13/f27 alias
prior_research_records.use: Conflict locator and historical research summary only; older raw samples were not re-read.
Prior alignment report documenting the historical f13/f27 alias conclusion; not used as a substitute for retained raw evidence.

public_evidence.claim: A public reverse-engineered Eastmoney API reference lists ulist/clist f13 as the market field.
public_evidence.authority_limit: Third-party reverse-engineered documentation, not an official stable Eastmoney API contract.

public_evidence.claim: Beijing Stock Exchange issuer filing identifies 920118 (Taihu Yuanda) as a security code.
public_evidence.authority_limit: Exchange source confirms issuer/code, not Eastmoney field semantics.

public_evidence.claim: Eastmoney quote route places 920118 under the bj market path.
public_evidence.authority_limit: Page routing is corroborative public evidence, not a field schema contract.

f13.meaning: Eastmoney market marker; in the retained A-share universe, 1 identifies Shanghai and 0 identifies non-Shanghai listings (including sampled Shenzhen and Beijing securities).

f27.meaning: Same-source alias of the f13 market marker within the retained A-share universe; 80/80 retained observations are identical and nonconstant.

decision.cross_source_numeric_mapping: No direct numeric mapping to Tencent[0] is registered. In the retained sample Eastmoney uses 1/0 while Tencent uses 1/51/62; the sources' code spaces differ and 0 collapses Shenzhen and Beijing in this sample.
decision.confidence: high for f13 market-marker semantics in the captured A-share universe; high for f13/f27 alias on the retained sample; no claim for other Eastmoney instrument classes or future protocol versions.
